meta.title: Pasiva
meta.goal: Utiliza pasivas impersonales y de reportaje ('It is believed that', 'He is said to be') para distanciar al autor o comunicar rumores oficiales.

cards.title: Pasiva: qué expresa
cards.lede: Utiliza pasivas impersonales y de reportaje ('It is believed that', 'He is said to be') para distanciar al autor o comunicar rumores oficiales.

rows.value: It is widely acknowledged that climate change threatens global security.
The CEO is reported to be considering a major buyout.
The suspect is believed to have left the country.
New policies are currently being drafted by the committee.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: It + is/was + participio de reporte + that + cláusula · It is rumored that they will merge.
Sujeto + be + participio + to + infinitivo (simple/continuo/perfecto) · She is said to be rich.
The preliminary findings are not expected to be published until next year.
highlights: are not expected to be published

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: It is reported that negotiations have reached a stalemate in Geneva.
The tech giant is understood to be developing a quantum processor.
The fugitive is thought to have crossed the border under a false identity.
It has been demonstrated that the compound inhibits viral replication.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Pasiva impersonal (It is said that)
columns.rule: Introduce una creencia general usando 'It' como sujeto nulo
examples: It is alleged that the executive committed fraud.

columns.label: Pasiva personal (He is said to)
columns.rule: Hace del sujeto de la noticia el foco de la oración mediante un infinitivo
examples: The executive is alleged to have committed fraud.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: People is said that the company is going bankrupt.
It is said that the company is going bankrupt. / The company is said to be going bankrupt.
lines.note: No combines 'People' con la estructura pasiva de reporte; usa 'It is said' o el sujeto directo.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: Usa 'to have + participio' si la acción reportada ocurrió antes que el reporte.
Usa 'to be + -ing' si la acción reportada ocurre de manera simultánea.
Evita atribuir declaraciones sin verificar usando 'It is claimed that'.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: The missing artwork is believed ___ stolen during the early hours of Tuesday.
quiz.explain: 'To have been + participio' expresa una acción pasiva completada en el pasado.

quiz.q: ___ that the new tax reform will pass without major amendments.
quiz.explain: La pasiva impersonal requiere el sujeto preparatorio 'It' ('It is anticipated that').

quiz.q: ¿Cuál es la forma correcta de transformar 'People say he works 80 hours a week' a pasiva estilística personal?
options: He is said to work 80 hours a week.
It is said he to work 80 hours a week.
He says to work 80 hours a week.
He is saying to work 80 hours a week.
quiz.explain: Sujeto + is said + infinitivo presente ('to work').
